document: Alone Against The Frost Solitaire Adventure in Canadas Wilds (Glenn Rahman  Gavin Inglis) (z-library.sk, 1lib.sk, z-lib.sk).pdf

paragraphs.text:
Charlie  works  the  motor  and  the  rest  of  your  group  pitch 
in  with  paddles.  You  spend  a  peaceful  first  day  returning 
downriver.  The  next  day  out,  a  downpour  turns  the  water 
savage, whisking you around a cliff-bound bend and down a 
mile-long sequence of rapids.

Make a Pilot (Boat) roll: if you succeed, go to 411; if you fail, go 
to 412.
